def gen_input(n: int, seed: int) -> str:
    count = max(1, min(n, 1_000_000))
    values = [str(((index * 1_103_515_245 + seed) % 2001) - 1000) for index in range(count)]
    queries = []
    for index in range(count):
        left = (index * 97 + seed) % count
        width = 1 + ((index * 31 + seed) % min(32, count))
        right = min(count, left + width)
        queries.append(f"{left} {right}")
    return f"{count} {count}\n" + " ".join(values) + "\n" + "\n".join(queries) + "\n"
